items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: So that's how I got to meet little Pecoraro... And he played a few jobs with us, with the dance band part of the Donbusters.

ctx.x: Uh, Fred Lloyd Cantor read pretty good on guitar. In the sax section, we were all side readers. Uh-huh. When did you start writing? I don't know. I always liked it. And, uh, I, I could never play piano, but I would use a piano just to, to sound chords. I still can't play. I can just make a chord if I studied my fingers long enough. But, uh, I would say, within five years from the time I started, I just liked it. It was a creative thing that I liked, you know, that you could write something and make people play…
We're talking about the early and mid-30s now, are we?
